rules_cc_compatibility_fix.reason: Bazel 9.2 and transitive C++ rules still resolve the removed grep-includes target. Backport the upstream restoration without upgrading Bazel or changing the toolchain versions.

license_acceptance_basis: User explicitly accepted both Microsoft Visual Studio and Windows SDK licenses in the conversation before the MSVC build.

msvc_followup_fixes.issue: AWS-LC jitterentropy passed GCC-only options to clang-cl.
msvc_followup_fixes.fix: Select the MSVC argument branch for both clang-cl and cl.exe, matching the CMake driver convention.

msvc_followup_fixes.issue: Cargo build scripts changed directory while retaining execroot-relative MSVC SDK and VFS paths.
msvc_followup_fixes.fix: Normalize /clang: wrappers, rebase SDK/overlay paths, then preserve the original driver syntax.

msvc_followup_fixes.issue: The upstream comma-separated feature example is a single feature value in Bazel 9.2; emitted commands still used /MD.
msvc_followup_fixes.fix: Use separate --features and --host_features occurrences to disable dynamic CRT and enable static CRT.

msvc_followup_fixes.issue: SDK overlay entries depended on the original compiler working directory; a global relocation fix also changed Bazel dependency paths.
msvc_followup_fixes.fix: Generate a relocatable overlay for compiler argument exports without source_file, retaining the original overlay for native compilation.

msvc_followup_fixes.issue: libclang ignored MSVC-style compiler flags because it did not receive the clang-cl executable name.
msvc_followup_fixes.fix: Select --driver-mode=cl for the MSVC compiler convention and parse the validated headers through one in-memory C wrapper, avoiding bindgen's GCC-style forced includes.

msvc_followup_fixes.issue: CMake selected a dynamic CRT and passed lib.exe archive arguments to llvm-ar.
msvc_followup_fixes.fix: In the browser transport CMake toolchain, select MultiThreaded and the declared llvm-lib tool for windows-msvc.

msvc_followup_fixes.issue: Bundled BoringSSL forced -fmsc-version=1900, conflicting with the declared SDK compatibility version.
msvc_followup_fixes.fix: Backport the exact upstream removal of the obsolete compatibility flag.

msvc_followup_fixes.issue: The direct Rust linker filter discarded clang-cl-wrapped SDK and CRT library paths.
msvc_followup_fixes.fix: Unwrap and preserve only declared library search paths, VFS overlays and the hermetic environment option for direct MSVC linking.

msvc_followup_fixes.issue: ring treated clang-cl as non-Clang on Windows ARM64 and replaced the configured compiler with a PATH lookup.
msvc_followup_fixes.fix: Accept both cc compiler-family variants of Clang and preserve the declared clang-cl path.
